args.description: Redraw this SAME left-facing purple-winged bat to fit ENTIRELY in this48x28 canvas. Both wings spread mostly horizontally, tiny body14x16, full wingspan44-48px and total height24-28px. Preserve character and shaded wing membranes, upper-left light and crisp pixels. preparation.postProcessing: Native body preserved; no resizing. Constant integer padding/translation. Nearest role palette RGB mapping, binary alpha.
